metadata.scope: Read-only design proposal, no implementation or numerical signoff

shared_rules_followup.terminology: Rubble layer plus one elemental layer: Fire, Ice or Electrified. Light remains independent. Electrified replaces the earlier proposed surface name Charge; elemental replaces energy as the layer name.
shared_rules_followup.burn_removal: Confirmed: remove the damaging Burn status and Poison entirely. Preserve top-level burn: true as Exhaust.
shared_rules_followup.surface_timing: Fire and Ice trigger only on actual tile entry or the affected actor turn start, never on placement. Fire initial tuning is 1 damage on entry and 2 on its own turn start, once per actor event even for a large footprint. Rubble instead changes ordinary entry movement cost directly; Electrified is a passive conduit until explicitly used.
shared_rules_followup.chilled: Entering Ice or beginning a non-Frozen activation on Ice activates Chilled while the actor remains on Ice. Painting Ice beneath a stationary actor does not activate Chilled. Leaving Ice or removing the supporting Ice clears Chilled. Ordinary non-Ice hits do not consume it. Frozen actors cannot gain Chilled, including during their skipped activation.
shared_rules_followup.damage_initial_tuning: Initial proposal: +1 damage on every direct hit against active Chilled. If already Frozen, use the shared x2 damage multiplier instead of adding the Chilled bonus. Neither numerical value is final balance signoff.
shared_rules_followup.ice_hit_order: Immediately before each individual hit, inspect active Chilled and Frozen state. Resolve damage using that pre-hit state, then an eligible Ice hit applies Freeze and consumes the enabling Ice beneath the actor. For a large actor, consume all Ice tiles it occupies once; clear Chilled. Ice painters place Ice only after their hit; this placement cannot activate Chilled or retroactively Freeze the target.
shared_rules_followup.frozen: Frozen is nonrefreshable and cannot coexist with regained Chilled. It skips its activation and thaws after that skipped activation; that Frozen turn start does not activate Ice. Newly painted Ice waits for a later actual entry or non-Frozen turn start. There is no additional recovery state, Thawing state or recovery guardrail.
shared_rules_followup.electrified_order: Electrified is immediately usable after placement. A later damaging Lightning attack can discharge its connected component, and intrinsic Chain can use individual nodes. An earlier separately printed placement action may enable a later attack on the same card. Ordinary post-hit placement arrives after the complete attack and cannot recursively expand that attack.
shared_rules_followup.chain: Confirmed direction: intrinsic Chain N preserves the current maximum jump reach; there is no additional-target cap. Individual Electrified tiles may act as nodes under normal Chain reach, including air-gap jumps that ordinary conduction cannot make. A non-Lightning attack granted Chain may use this node routing without becoming Lightning.
shared_rules_followup.lightning_conduction: Confirmed direction: a damaging Lightning impact touching Electrified discharges the cardinally contiguous connected component and hits its opponent occupants. No Chain keyword is required. Diagonal contact, nearby enemies off the component and air gaps do not conduct. Lightning support, movement and placement alone do not discharge.
shared_rules_followup.lightning_consumption: Design recommendation for tuning: discharge consumes the whole touched Electrified component, including its empty branches. Chain-only relay use consumes its actually used nodes. Neither surface visits nor consumption are actor hits. The full-component consumption policy is an explicit design recommendation, not numeric or playtest signoff.
shared_rules_followup.lightning_resolution: Take one pre-attack snapshot. Plan intrinsic Chain independently; collect each touched cardinal component; union native, Chain and conduction opponent targets and hit each actor once. Conduction does not start a fresh Chain head from every affected actor. Consume the planned ground once; separate later attacks and Flurry repeats see the remaining board. Post-attack painting cannot extend its own already planned attack.

cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Fire intensity by 1. Move 2, then strike for 4. Fire 2+: +4 damage and burn 2.
cards.proposal: Move, melee hit, then Fire under the struck target. Remove the intensity package. Movement and the hit are separate readable steps; it cannot trigger its new surface before placement resolves.

cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Fire intensity by 1. Deal 4 at range 4 and gain 1 card play. Fire 2+: +3 damage and burn 2.
cards.proposal: A light ranged hit followed by Detonate on its impact tile. Remove the automatic card-play refund; retain a short Time cost. It remains a modest legal attack without Fire, with a strong local payoff when prepared.

cards.name: Inferno Ritual
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Spend 2 Fire intensity. Deal 11 and burn 3 in a cross pattern at range 4.
cards.proposal: Modest cross-pattern damage plus Detonate on existing Fire in that pattern. Remove the intensity entry cost and Burn. It consumes real Fire; it never creates the Fire it consumes on this same action.

cards.name: Molten Reach
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Deal 5 along a 3-tile line at range 6. Fire 2+: +3 damage and burn 2.
cards.proposal: A rotatable three-tile damaging line followed by Fire along that line. Geometry distinguishes it from Cinder Bloom; remove its intensity bonus and Burn rider.

cards.name: Wildfire Halo
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Deal 5 in a large pattern at range 5. Fire 3+: +9 damage and burn 3.
cards.proposal: Large-pattern damage and Detonate on existing Fire in the pattern. No global board detonation and no automatic repaint after consumption. Payoff bounded by the printed pattern; remove intensity and Burn.

cards.name: Frostbolt
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Ice intensity by 1. Deal 4 at range 6. Ice 2+: +1 damage and freeze.
cards.proposal: A ranged Ice hit, then Ice beneath its target. Check active Chilled immediately before the hit: if eligible, damage resolves before Freeze consumes the supporting Ice. Newly painted Ice does not activate Chilled until a later actual entry or non-Frozen turn start. Remove intensity generation and direct gated Freeze.

cards.name: Icebound Chains
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Deal 6 at range 6 and immobilize, then gain truesight for 2 turns.
cards.proposal: Keep ranged Ice damage, Immobilize and Truesight. An actively Chilled target can Freeze after damage, consuming all Ice it occupies. Immobilize can hold an un-Frozen target on Ice until its turn-start activation. Avoid adding free Ice placement to this dense control/information card.

cards.name: Rime Shard
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Ice intensity by 1. Deal 2 along a 2-tile line at range 5. Ice 2+: +2 damage.
cards.proposal: Modest damage along the existing two-tile line, then Ice on that line. No intensity. Each hit checks active Chilled before damage; painting Ice afterwards neither Chills a stationary occupant nor self-enables Freeze for the completed hit.

cards.name: Cold Grasp
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Ice intensity by 1 and strike up to range 2 for 6. Ice 2+: +3 damage and freeze.
cards.proposal: Keep strong short-reach Ice damage. It does not lay Ice; its control payoff requires reaching a target whose Chilled was activated by actual Ice entry or a non-Frozen turn start. Eligible Freeze consumes the Ice beneath that actor and clears Chilled; ordinary hits do not consume Chilled.

cards.name: Icicle Lance
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Ice intensity by 1 and pierce for 5 at range 5. Ice 3+: +4 damage and freeze.
cards.proposal: Keep ranged Pierce and Ice damage. Remove intensity; the shared rule checks active Chilled immediately before the hit, resolves damage, then applies eligible Freeze and consumes the enabling Ice. Do not create Ice on this specialist payoff.

cards.name: Hush of Winter
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Spend 2 Ice intensity. Deal 9 at range 7, freeze, and draw 1.
cards.proposal: Keep long-range Ice damage and draw, with Freeze only against active Chilled; Freeze consumes the Ice beneath its target. No resource lock; price range and draw without assuming Freeze is always available or refreshable.

cards.name: Shatterline
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Pierce a line for 5 at range 5. Ice 3+: +5 damage and freeze.
cards.proposal: Keep a three-tile piercing Ice line. Each individual hit checks active Chilled immediately before damage, then applies eligible Freeze and consumes the Ice beneath that actor once. No newly generated Ice and no intensity-gated damage package; do not snapshot Chill once for the entire action.

cards.name: Glacier Pin
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Ice intensity by 1. Deal 4 in a two-tile pattern at range 5. Ice 3+: +4 damage and freeze.
cards.proposal: Damage the existing short line, then lay Ice on its floor tiles. Make area/range or a bounded Immobilize rider distinguish it from Rime Shard. Painting Ice does not Chill stationary occupants: actual entry or a later non-Frozen turn start activates it for a future freezing hit.

cards.name: White Silence
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Deal 9 at range 7. Ice 3+: +8 damage and freeze.
cards.proposal: A heavy long-range Ice finisher. Against an already Frozen target, use the shared x2 damage payoff instead of stacking Chilled +1 or another bespoke multiplier. Against active Chilled, damage resolves before Freeze consumes the enabling Ice. It never refreshes Freeze or grants Chilled to a Frozen target; rarity comes from its printed attack budget and reach.

cards.name: Spark Dart
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Lightning intensity by 1. Deal 4 at range 6, then create radius-1 Light at the impact for 2 turns. Lightning 2+: +3 damage.
cards.proposal: Keep a straightforward ranged Lightning hit and existing impact Light, then Electrified beneath the primary impact after the complete attack. The single tile is a useful endpoint or gap filler alongside broader painters. Hitting an existing Electrified component already supplies the shared conduction payoff; no extra card-specific condition is needed.

cards.name: Chain Bolt
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Lightning intensity by 1. Deal 4 at range 5 with chain 1. Lightning 2+: +3 damage and +1 chain.
cards.proposal: Ranged Chain damage without intensity or Shock. Preserve Chain N as maximum jump reach, with no additional-target cap. It works through nearby enemies without setup and can treat individual Electrified tiles as relay nodes. Its Lightning impacts can also discharge touched contiguous components under the shared contract.

cards.name: Spark Focus
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Lightning intensity by 2. Deal 4 at range 5, draw 1, then gain 1 vision for 2 turns.
cards.proposal: Place a short cardinally contiguous Electrified line on visible legal floor, then draw. Tune its length to connect useful nearby occupied tiles or complete a gap in existing ground, rather than leave two isolated nodes. Remove intensity and the redundant small attack; retain Vision only if the support budget allows. Empty-floor targeting makes this a broadly useful setup card.

cards.name: Static Lash
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Lightning intensity by 1. Deal 4 at range 6. Lightning 2+: +4 damage and shock.
cards.proposal: Keep a simple ranged Lightning hit. Its specialist Shock applies to actual opponents reached through used Electrified, whether by contiguous conduction or intrinsic Chain supplied elsewhere. The ordinary connected-component payoff does not require Chain. Remove intensity and unconditional turn denial; no extra setup condition is needed for the baseline hit.

cards.name: Storm Relay
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Spend 2 Lightning intensity. Deal 9 at range 6 with chain 2 and shock.
cards.proposal: A ranged Chain attack with greater printed jump reach, not a larger additional-target budget. Used Electrified can enable its explicitly priced Shock rider. Remove intensity cost. Plan its native Chain independently of component hits and deduplicate the final actor union; empty tiles are not hits or reward triggers.

cards.name: Volt Surge
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Raise Lightning intensity by 1. Deal 5 at range 6. Lightning 2+: +4 damage.
cards.proposal: Replace the redundant intensity shot with one coherent damaging line that leaves a cardinally contiguous Electrified lane AFTER the complete attack. Tune line coverage to connect typical nearby positions without needing several painter cards for one useful discharge. Existing Electrified touched by the attack conducts normally; newly painted ground waits only for a later attack.

cards.name: Thunderline
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Deal 6 in a line at range 6. Lightning 3+: +9 damage and shock.
cards.proposal: Keep the rotatable damaging line and an explicitly rooted intrinsic Chain, with its number controlling jump reach. The line can discharge each Electrified component it touches. Snapshot the native line and Chain route independently of conduction, then hit their combined opponent union once; no fresh Chain starts from every line tile or conducted target.

cards.name: Gust Step

cards.current_description: Raise Air intensity by 1. Pull 2 at range 4 and hit for 4. Air 2+: gain 1 card play.
cards.proposal: Directed Pull plus modest damage; replace the intensity/refund package with a small Move AFTER the pull. Resolve target movement before player movement. This is a setup bridge without free card-play churn.

cards.name: Updraft

cards.current_description: Raise Air intensity by 1. Push 2 at range 4 and hit 6. Air 2+: gain 1 card play.
cards.proposal: Keep directed Push and damage, remove intensity and card-play refund, and tune short Time to make a satisfying common setup tool. It pays for actual hazard traversal, not an automatic extra play.

cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Spend 2 Air intensity. Pull 5 at range 5, hit for 11, and draw 1.
cards.proposal: Keep long-range/long-distance directed Pull, modest damage and draw. Remove intensity cost. It can drag through prepared hazards; reduce old spender-level damage if hazard value warrants it.

cards.current_description: Raise Air intensity by 1. Deal 5 in an odd pattern at range 5 and push 1. Air 2+: gain 1 card play.
cards.proposal: Keep the unusual rotatable pattern with Push. Remove intensity and refund. Preview each actor's route, collision and surface entries before committing.

A target with active Chilled before the hit can Freeze, consuming its supporting Ice. Otherwise the new Ice waits for an actual entry or non-Frozen turn start; it does not immediately Chill or Freeze an occupant.

cards.name: Storm Jar
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Consume. Deal 3 at range 4, shock 1, and chain 1.
cards.proposal: Retain a straightforward consumable Lightning Chain attack under the shared jump-reach convention. Its specialist Shock can require an opponent actually reached through used Electrified; both contiguous conduction and individual Chain relays qualify. Prior explicit placement is immediately usable, but this attack cannot reuse a component already consumed by an earlier attack.

cards.name: Smoke Bomb
cards.disposition: retain role; compatibility and balance review
cards.current_description: Consume. Blink 2 and gain 2 block.
cards.proposal: Blink skips intermediate terrain and triggers only landing-tile effects, with any explicit origin effects retained. Keep defense/healing semantics; include shared Fire damage and prevention in the revised valuation.

cards.name: Jaw Trap
cards.disposition: retain role; compatibility and balance review
cards.current_description: Consume. Clamp a target at range 3 for 3 and immobilize.
cards.proposal: Retain printed direct attacks; surfaces are applied only when explicitly printed, and physical direct hits benefit from active Chilled damage but do not apply Freeze. Immobilize remains movement denial and gains situational value by holding a unit on hazardous terrain; re-score rather than silently add another rider.

cards.proposal: Remove Poison, retain modest piercing small-blast damage and leave Rubble in the pattern. Consider Earth tag and a clearer Quarry Dust name; preserve Consume, with no periodic damage replacement.

cards.name: Cinder Fusillade
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Flurry. Gain 1 fire intensity, then deal 3 at range 6, for each card play spent.
cards.proposal: For each snapped card play, make a modest ranged hit and leave Fire at that hit's tile AFTER resolution. Repeated hits on the same Fire do not stack tile strength, trigger entry again or refund card plays.

cards.name: Storm Salvo
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Flurry. Deal 3 at range 6 with chain 1, then draw 1, for each card play spent.
cards.proposal: Retain repeated modest Lightning Chain attacks and review draw per repeat. Chain N remains jump reach with no additional-target cap. Each explicit Flurry repeat takes its own pre-attack snapshot: an earlier consumed component or relay stays gone unless a later explicit placement recreates it. Deduplicate native hits, Chain and contiguous conduction within each repeat; conducted targets do not start new Chain heads.

cards.name: Razor Gale
cards.disposition: mechanical rewrite / role adjustment
cards.current_description: Flurry. Deal 3 at range 5 and push 1 for each card play spent.
cards.proposal: Retain repeated ranged damage and directed Push; every repeat shows its updated actual path and entry effects. Preserve normal Flurry commitment and review Fire traversal farming, kill refunds and exhausted movement routes.
